name: Amardeep Singh
headline: Applied AI engineer
intro: I build AI systems that are easier to inspect, test, and trust—from retrieval and agent workflows to bounded robotics interfaces.
open_to: Interested in applied AI, retrieval, inference, and robotics problems where reliability matters.
principles: Keep model outputs structured and inspectable.
Validate proposals before they cross a tool or actuator boundary.
Use tests, replayable examples, and explicit limitations as evidence.
